_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6), recalibrated 2026-06-10 from the FIRST REAL gpt-4o capture (runbook step 5, the same ~5pp-under-measured calibration the coverage floor used in #36). Measured baseline (report.json @ prompt_version f3a5ad27, 60 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (36/36), T4_answer_correct 0.78 (28/36), out_of_scope_honest 0.75 (18/24). Floors sit ~5pp under with extra headroom for temperature=0 re-capture jitter (1 in-scope case = 2.8pp). Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
